systemView.OverallMetricsTips: For the Ascend Hardware layer, events are further broken down into computation, communication, and idle events. Computation breaks down the time spent on key operators such as FA and MM, while communication breaks down transfer and wait times by communication domain. Collected events must include CPU (framework-side) and NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include both ProfilerActivity.CPU and ProfilerActivity.NPU. The collection level must be L1 or higher. To further obtain sub-level classification of computation time, the AI Core performance metric must be set to PipeUtilization.
systemView.OperatorDetailsTips: The statistics of the operator details table summarized by type, the collection items are the same as the operator details table
systemView.PythonAPISummaryTips: Statistics for Python layer events. Collected events must include CPU (framework-side) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.CPU.
systemView.PythonAPITraceTips: Lists individual Python layer APIs by start time. Collected events must include CPU (framework-side) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.CPU.
systemView.CANNAPISummaryTips: Statistics for CANN layer events. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU.
systemView.CANNAPITraceTips: Lists individual CANN layer APIs by start time. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU.
systemView.AscendHardWareTaskSummaryTips: Statistics for Ascend Hardware layer events. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU.
systemView.AscendHardWareTaskTraceTips: Lists individual Ascend Hardware layer operators by start time. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU.
systemView.CommunicationSummaryTips: Statistics for Communication layer events. The collection level must be L1 or higher.
systemView.CommunicationTraceTips: Lists individual Communication layer streams by start time. The collection level must be L1 or higher.
systemView.OverlapAnalysisTips: Categorized statistics of computation, communication, and idle events for the Ascend Hardware layer. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU. To obtain the Communication breakdown results, the collection level must be L1 or higher.
systemView.KernelDetailsTips: Detailed information for Ascend Hardware layer (i.e., NPU) operators. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU. To further obtain operator type, accelerator core, and input/output shapes, the collection level must be L1 or higher.
systemView.ExpertAnalysisTips: Analysis of NPU frequency throttling, which can affect NPU computation performance. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU.
systemView.AffinityAPITips: Analyzes APIs that could be replaced with affinity alternatives. Collected events must include CPU (framework-side) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.CPU.
systemView.AffinityOptimizerTips: Analyzes optimizers that could be replaced with affinity alternatives. Collected events must include CPU (framework-side) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.CPU.
systemView.AICPUOperatorsTips: AICPU operators may not fully utilize AI Core resources. Consider reducing AI CPU-type operators as suggested in the notes. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU. The collection level must be L1 or higher.
systemView.ACLNNOperatorsTips: Analyzes ACLNN operators that could be optimized. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU.
systemView.OperatorsFusionTips: Identifies operators that could be replaced with fused alternatives. See the Ascend Extension for PyTorch fused operator replacement documentation. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU. The collection level must be L1 or higher.
systemView.OperatorsDispatchTips: Identifies time-consuming aclOpCompile operations during operator dispatch. Consider disabling online compilation as suggested in the notes. Collected events must include NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data. For example, when using the PyTorch Profiler API, the activities config must include ProfilerActivity.NPU.
systemView.KernelE2ETimeTips: End-to-end kernel dispatch time statistics, showing per-stage durations, status, and diagnostic information for each operator dispatch pipeline. Click a table row to highlight the corresponding Timeline slices for that pipeline. Collected events must include CPU (framework-side) and NPU (CANN software stack and NPU hardware layer) data.

npuMetrics.biuPerfGroupAiv: Displays SU, VEC, CUBE, MTE instruction execution time and marker data on the specified Group and AIV.
npuMetrics.ubUdmaPorts: Displays UB receive and transmit bandwidth data for the specified UDMA port.
npuMetrics.ubUnicPorts: Displays UB receive and transmit bandwidth data for the specified UNIC port.
npuMetrics.blockDetailAicEarliest: Displays the execution time of the operator on the earliest AI Core.
npuMetrics.blockDetailAicLatest: Displays the execution time of the operator on the latest AI Core.
npuMetrics.blockDetailAivEarliest: Displays the execution time of the operator on the earliest AI Vector Core.
npuMetrics.blockDetailAivLatest: Displays the execution time of the operator on the latest AI Vector Core.

npuMetrics.hbmWrite: Displays memory write rate data for the specified HBM channel.
npuMetrics.ddrRead: Displays DDR memory read rate data.
npuMetrics.ddrWrite: Displays DDR memory write rate data.
npuMetrics.llcReadHitRate: Displays read hit rate data for the specified LLC.
npuMetrics.llcWriteHitRate: Displays write hit rate data for the specified LLC.
npuMetrics.llcReadThroughput: Displays read throughput data for the specified LLC.
npuMetrics.llcWriteThroughput: Displays write throughput data for the specified LLC.
npuMetrics.npuMemAppDdr: Displays process-level DDR memory usage data.
npuMetrics.npuMemAppHbm: Displays process-level HBM memory usage data.
npuMetrics.npuMemAppMemory: Displays total process-level DDR and HBM memory usage data.
npuMetrics.npuMemDeviceDdr: Displays device-level DDR memory usage data.
npuMetrics.npuMemDeviceHbm: Displays device-level HBM memory usage data.
npuMetrics.npuMemDeviceMemory: Displays total device-level DDR and HBM memory usage data.
npuMetrics.starsSocL2BufferBwLevel: Displays the L2 Buffer bandwidth level in SoC transfer bandwidth information.
npuMetrics.starsSocMetaBwLevel: Displays the Meta bandwidth level in SoC transfer bandwidth information.
npuMetrics.accPmuReadBwLevel: Displays read bandwidth data for the specified DVPP or DSA accelerator.
npuMetrics.accPmuReadOstLevel: Displays read concurrency data for the specified DVPP or DSA accelerator.
npuMetrics.accPmuWriteBwLevel: Displays write bandwidth data for the specified DVPP or DSA accelerator.
npuMetrics.accPmuWriteOstLevel: Displays write concurrency data for the specified DVPP or DSA accelerator.
npuMetrics.aiCoreUtilizationAverage: Displays the average AI Core instruction ratio.
npuMetrics.aiCoreUtilizationCore: Displays the total cycle ratio of tasks executed on the specified AI Core.
npuMetrics.sioDatRx: Displays receive bandwidth data for the data stream channel.
npuMetrics.sioDatTx: Displays transmit bandwidth data for the data stream channel.
npuMetrics.sioReqRx: Displays receive bandwidth data for the request stream channel.
npuMetrics.sioReqTx: Displays transmit bandwidth data for the request stream channel.
npuMetrics.sioRspRx: Displays receive bandwidth data for the response stream channel.
npuMetrics.sioRspTx: Displays transmit bandwidth data for the response stream channel.
npuMetrics.sioSnpRx: Displays receive bandwidth data for the snoop stream channel.
npuMetrics.sioSnpTx: Displays transmit bandwidth data for the snoop stream channel.
npuMetrics.qosOthers: Displays device bandwidth information for the specified QoS channel.
npuMetrics.nicPortRx: Displays receive network information or receive bandwidth data for the specified NIC port.
npuMetrics.nicPortTx: Displays transmit network information or transmit bandwidth data for the specified NIC port.
npuMetrics.rocePortRx: Displays receive bandwidth data for the specified RoCE communication interface.
npuMetrics.rocePortTx: Displays transmit bandwidth data for the specified RoCE communication interface.
npuMetrics.pcieCpl: Displays PCIe bandwidth data for receiving completion packets of write requests.
npuMetrics.pcieNonpost: Displays PCIe Non-Posted data transfer bandwidth.
npuMetrics.pciePost: Displays PCIe Posted data transfer bandwidth.
npuMetrics.hccsTxThroughput: Displays HCCS collective communication transmit bandwidth data.
npuMetrics.hccsRxThroughput: Displays HCCS collective communication receive bandwidth data.
npuMetrics.biuGroupBandwidthRead: Displays BIU read instruction bandwidth data.
npuMetrics.biuGroupBandwidthWrite: Displays BIU write instruction bandwidth data.
npuMetrics.biuGroupLatencyRead: Displays BIU read instruction latency data.
npuMetrics.biuGroupLatencyWrite: Displays BIU write instruction latency data.
npuMetrics.aicCoreGroupCube: Displays the cycle count and ratio of matrix computation instructions.
npuMetrics.coreGroupMte1: Displays the cycle count and ratio of data movement instructions from L1 to L0A/L0B.

npuMetrics.coreGroupMte3: Displays the cycle count and ratio of data movement instructions from AICORE to on-chip memory.
npuMetrics.aivCoreGroupScalar: Displays the cycle count and ratio of scalar computation instructions.
npuMetrics.aivCoreGroupVector: Displays the cycle count and ratio of vector computation instructions.
npuMetrics.starsChipTransPaLinkRx: Displays coarse-grained statistics for the PA link receive traffic level.
npuMetrics.starsChipTransPaLinkTx: Displays coarse-grained statistics for the PA link transmit traffic level.
npuMetrics.starsChipTransPcieReadBandwidth: Displays coarse-grained statistics for PCIe read bandwidth.
npuMetrics.starsChipTransPcieWriteBandwidth: Displays coarse-grained statistics for PCIe write bandwidth.
npuMetrics.lowPower: Displays low-power data such as power consumption, bandwidth, frequency, and temperature.
npuMetrics.biuPerf: Displays SU, VEC, CUBE, MTE instruction execution time and marker data.
npuMetrics.ub: Displays overall UDMA and UNIC receive/transmit bandwidth data.
npuMetrics.blockDetail: Displays operator execution time on the earliest or latest AI Core/AI Vector Core.
npuMetrics.hbm: Displays HBM memory read/write rate data.
npuMetrics.ddr: Displays DDR memory read/write rate data.
npuMetrics.llc: Displays LLC read/write hit rate and throughput data.
npuMetrics.npuMem: Displays process-level or device-level DDR, HBM, and total NPU memory usage data.
npuMetrics.starsSoc: Displays SoC transfer bandwidth information, including L2 Buffer and Meta bandwidth levels.
npuMetrics.accPmu: Displays DVPP and DSA accelerator read/write bandwidth and concurrency information.
npuMetrics.aiCoreUtilization: Displays AI Core instruction ratio data, including the average and each AI Core total cycle ratio.
npuMetrics.aiCoreFreq: Displays AI Core frequency changes during AI task execution.
npuMetrics.sio: Displays receive/transmit bandwidth data for data, request, response, and snoop stream channels.
npuMetrics.nic: Displays network information or network bandwidth information; lane names vary with data.
npuMetrics.roce: Displays RoCE communication interface receive/transmit bandwidth data.
npuMetrics.pcie: Displays PCIe data transfer bandwidth and Non-Posted transfer latency.
npuMetrics.hccs: Displays HCCS collective communication transmit and receive bandwidth data.
npuMetrics.biuGroup: Displays BIU read/write instruction bandwidth and latency data.
npuMetrics.aicCoreGroup: Displays AIC matrix computation and data movement instruction cycle counts and ratios.
npuMetrics.aivCoreGroup: Displays AIV data movement, scalar, and vector instruction cycle counts and ratios.
npuMetrics.starsChipTrans: Displays coarse-grained statistics for PA link receive/transmit traffic levels and PCIe read/write bandwidth.
